description: Assistant tool: catch-me-up summary of recent mail - counts, categories, what needs a reply, and a short written digest.

tools.name: daily_digest
tools.description: Summarize what arrived in the mailbox recently (default: last 24 hours): totals, categories, which threads need a reply, and a brief written digest. Use when the user asks to catch up, 'what did I miss', or for a digest.

max_read.description: how many messages to read for the digest (default 10)
